task_spec: SUBJECT: Give the app a header bar carrying two tabs - Reconstruct playlists and Reconnect wizard - so both operations are visible at once and the operator can see which one they are on, styled from the design set's own header rather than from a link at the bottom of the page.
SETTLED by the operator: Reconstruct playlists is the LEFTMOST tab and the DEFAULT - the route the app opens on. The reconnect wizard is the second, optional one.

SETTLED by the operator: the shell is Main.dc.html's header bar (.hd - brand mark, divider, task) plus the tabs, applied to both routes. The page bodies stay as they are; the footer action bar and the card treatment are NOT in scope.
SETTLED by the operator: the header and its tab states are drawn into design/reconnect-wizard/Specs.dc.html FIRST and built to, keeping DL-071 intact.

scope: traktor_nml/gui/app.py (the two routes and _page_chrome), traktor_nml/gui/theme.py (header and tab rules built from tokens it already carries), design/reconnect-wizard/Specs.dc.html, tests/, traktor_nml/README.md, and the gate repository's serve_w002.py and README.md

out-of-scope: accessibility work - no screen-reader verification, no NVDA, no new keyboard bindings. Mouse and clicking is this version's bar. The existing keyboard contract and announcements stay as they are
out-of-scope: the four wizard steps' own layout, the conflict screen, the footer action bar, the card treatment
out-of-scope: any new colour - theme.py already carries every colour Main.dc.html's header uses
constraints: MUST: swapping the routes is the whole of 'default selected' - the reconstruct page answers '/' and the reconnect wizard moves to its own path. Every caller of the old paths is enumerated and updated in the same change

MUST: the gate's serve_w002.py drives the reconnect wizard and its recorded procedure opens it at '/' on port 8115 - that script and C:\codex\traktor-nml-tool-gate/README.md are updated with the route, and the change is stated rather than left for a later session to trip on

MUST: docs/2026-08-28-w002-browser-record.md and docs/2026-08-29-w004-focus-ring-record.md are RECORDS of runs already taken - they are not rewritten to match a new route; anything said about them describes what they recorded

MUST: new header and tab rules are built from tokens theme.py already carries (GROUND, SURFACE_2, BORDER, BORDER_STRONG, TEXT, TEXT_FAINT, ACTION, SURFACE_4 and the type scale); no hex literal reaches app.py, which a guard enforces
MUST: the nicegui boundary (DL-069) - theme.py imports no nicegui and holds the stylesheet; app.py may import nicegui. Any rule worth testing sits below the boundary
MUST: app.py stays 100% CRLF (1612 CRLF, 0 bare LF); theme.py and the tests are LF. Read and write with newline=''
MUST: every guard is made to FAIL first, and its docstring records the specific mutation applied and the specific output observed
MUST: a served-page gate run before the change lands - gui/ defects are only ever found by serving the page (DL-084), and both routes are driven
MUST: new decisions continue from the current high-water mark in traktor_nml/README.md (DL-128 at the time of writing - re-read and confirm)
MUST: documentation describes the code as it stands - no 'previously', 'now does', 'no longer', 'added'
MUST NOT: regenerate the parity manifest or the gate fixture; never restore a file with git checkout
SHOULD: the suite runs under the SYSTEM interpreter, currently 473 passed / 3 skipped, not .venv (474/2)
SHOULD: a tab is a link the browser can follow, not a client-side toggle - the two routes are separate pages and each is reachable by its own URL
entry_points: traktor_nml/gui/app.py:_page_chrome (~156) - the colour, dark-mode and stylesheet preamble both routes already share, and the natural place a shared header is rendered from

traktor_nml/gui/app.py:build_wizard (~168) - registers the reconnect wizard at '/' and ends with ui.link('Reconstruct playlists from another collection', '/reconstruct') at line 207, the link this work replaces
traktor_nml/gui/theme.py:page_stylesheet - the string every rule is built into; a '#' comment inside it is an ID selector that swallows the rule after it with no parse error

design/reconnect-wizard/Main.dc.html - the header the operator asked for: .hd, .hd-l, .brand, .bar, .task, and the .rail/.st step treatment whose active state (.st.now - SURFACE_4 ground, inset border, TEXT ink) is the pattern a selected tab follows
design/reconnect-wizard/Specs.dc.html - the cross-screen contract, which describes no app-level navigation
C:\codex\traktor-nml-tool-gate/serve_w002.py - serves the reconnect wizard on port 8115; its recorded driving order opens '/'
C:\codex\traktor-nml-tool-gate/serve_reconstruct.py - serves the reconstruct page on port 8116 and already opens '/reconstruct'
rejected_alternatives: Keep the bottom link and add tabs beside it - two ways to reach one page, and the link is what the operator asked to replace

A client-side tab toggle rendering both operations on one page - the two share no pipeline and /reconstruct is a separate route for that reason (app.py's own docstring); a toggle would also cost each operation its own URL
Redirect '/' to '/reconstruct' and leave the wizard registered at '/' as well - two paths answering for one page, and a redirect the gate has to know about anyway
Take the whole shell - header, footer action bar and card treatment - rejected by the operator as scope for this change
current_understanding: the operator reaches the second operation through ui.link('Reconstruct playlists from another collection', '/reconstruct') at the bottom of the wizard page, and there is no link back
nothing on either page names the other operation or says which one is open
the reconstruct page is the operator's own critical use case, which is why it is the one they want to land on
_page_chrome is already shared by both routes precisely so a second route cannot drift from the wizard's theme (DL-078, DL-085), so a header rendered there reaches both by construction
theme.py carries every colour Main.dc.html's header uses; this is layout and structure rather than a new palette
app.py carries no hex literal, comments included, and a guard enforces it
assumptions: The reconnect wizard's new path is '/reconnect' (M) - the plan should name it and check nothing else claims it
The header shows the brand mark and the two tabs; Main.dc.html's .task element names the screen, which the tabs make redundant, so the plan should decide whether .task appears at all (M)
The gate's serve_w002.py needs only its recorded driving order updated with the wizard's path, not a code change, because it serves whatever app.py registers (M) - establish by reading
The four wizard steps and the conflict screen are unaffected because the header sits above the page body (H)
invisible_knowledge: Serving the page is the only gate that has ever caught a defect in gui/ (DL-084), and it caught the duplicate-entry defect after a green 473-test suite
A guard asserting the right value appeared can pass while the output is wrong - assert the count, the structure, or the thing a defect would change

Quasar's no-outline carries outline:0 !important inside a layer the page orders last and names quasar_importants; for !important the EARLIER layer wins, so an unlayered add_head_html rule loses at every specificity - DL-086's ladder, rung two, is re-opening Quasar's own layer
A token class carrying background and ink together wins only with color=None at the constructor
Tailwind's JIT emits rules asynchronously; NiceGUI's stepper unmounts inactive steps
The design set's own precedence rule: if a screen and Specs.dc.html disagree, fix Specs first, otherwise a per-screen fix silently forks the rule for every screen sharing it
design/reconnect-wizard/reconnect-wizard.html is the gitignored bundle seeded from the sources; only the .dc.html sources and canvas.json are committed
reference_docs: traktor_nml/README.md - the decision log and the authority; DL-069, DL-071, DL-078, DL-084, DL-085, DL-086 all bear
traktor_nml/gui/CLAUDE.md - the nicegui boundary, the file map, and where Specs and nicegui-gui-analysis.md disagree
design/reconnect-wizard/README.md - the design brief and its Specs-first precedence rule
C:\codex\traktor-nml-tool-gate/README.md - the gate's files, its path resolution and its recorded driving orders
